SELECT t.* FROM ( SELECT ub.id, ub.link_id AS linkId, ub.pm, ub.title, ub.category, ub.type, ub.number, ub.balance, ub.mark, ub.status, ub.create_time AS createTime, ub.update_time AS updateTime, u.nickname, ub.uid, u.phone, u.avatar, 'bill' AS sourceTable FROM eb_user_bill ub LEFT JOIN eb_user u ON ub.uid = u.uid WHERE ub.category IN ('now_money','brokerage_price') UNION ALL SELECT ir.id, ir.link_id AS linkId, (CASE WHEN ir.type = 1 THEN 1 WHEN ir.type = 2 THEN 0 ELSE ir.type END) AS pm, ir.title, 'integral' AS category, ir.link_type AS type, ir.integral AS number, ir.balance, ir.mark, ir.status, ir.create_time AS createTime, ir.update_time AS updateTime, u.nickname, ir.uid, u.phone, u.avatar, 'integral' AS sourceTable FROM eb_user_integral_record ir LEFT JOIN eb_user u ON ir.uid = u.uid UNION ALL SELECT br.id, br.link_id AS linkId, (CASE WHEN br.type = 1 THEN 1 WHEN br.type = 2 THEN 0 ELSE br.type END) AS pm, br.title, 'brokerage_price' AS category, br.link_type AS type, br.price AS number, br.balance, br.mark, br.status, br.create_time AS createTime, br.update_time AS updateTime, u.nickname, br.uid, u.phone, u.avatar, 'brokerage' AS sourceTable FROM eb_user_brokerage_record br LEFT JOIN eb_user u ON br.uid = u.uid ) t where 1 = 1
and t.title in #{tItem}
and (
t.title like CONCAT('%',#{tItem},'%')
)
and (t.createTime between #{startTime} and #{endTime})
and ( t.uid like CONCAT('%',#{keywords},'%') or t.nickname like CONCAT('%',#{keywords},'%') or t.phone like CONCAT('%',#{keywords},'%') )
and t.uid = #{uid}
and t.nickname like CONCAT('%',#{nickname},'%')
and t.phone like CONCAT('%',#{phone},'%')
and ( t.linkId like CONCAT('%',#{linkId},'%') or exists ( select 1 from eb_store_order so where so.order_id like CONCAT('%',#{linkId},'%') and (t.linkId = so.order_id or t.linkId = CONVERT(so.id, CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci) ) )
ORDER BY t.createTime DESC, t.id DESC

and ir.title in #{tItem}

ir.title like CONCAT('%',#{tItem},'%')
